items: Rinse the ribs, then blanch them in boiling water to draw out the scum; drain and rinse clean.

Peel the daikon and cut into large chunks. If the skin is old and thick (often the case outside Taiwan), salt-pickle the daikon first, squeeze out the water, and only then add it — this carries the bitterness away with the water instead of cooking it into the soup.
Cut the corn into segments and slice the ginger.
Put the ribs, ginger, corn and daikon in a pot and add the water to cover.
Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer gently for 40–60 minutes, until the ribs and daikon are tender and the broth turns sweet.
Season with salt to taste just before serving and scatter scallion on top.
排骨洗淨，入滾水汆燙逼出血水與雜質，撈起沖洗乾淨。
白蘿蔔削皮、切大塊。若蘿蔔皮較老較厚（住在海外常如此），建議先用鹽醃漬、擠乾水分後再下鍋——苦澀味會隨水分流掉，不會煮進湯裡。
將排骨、薑、玉米與白蘿蔔放入鍋中，加水蓋過食材。
大火煮滾後轉小火，慢燉 40～60 分鐘，至排骨與蘿蔔軟透、湯頭自然回甘。
起鍋前以鹽調味，撒上蔥花即可享用。
